name: Micah
overview: Micah is a male figure from the tribe of Reuben, identified uniquely as the son of Shimei. His lineage is noted in 1 Chronicles 5:5, highlighting his Reubenite heritage. There are no additional notes or distinguishing details beyond his tribal affiliation and paternal connection.
namesAndTitles: The name Micah means 'Who is like y-h-v-h?', reflecting a rhetorical question that emphasizes the incomparable nature of God. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 5:5, reveals a theological affirmation embedded in his identity.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Micah as the son of Shimei. It is also inferred that Reaiah is his father, establishing a paternal lineage within the Reubenite tribe. Beyond this, no further family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Micah's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the Reubenite tribe, as preserved in 1 Chronicles 5:5. His identification as the son of Shimei situates him within the broader narrative of Israel's tribal history. Though not prominent in other biblical events, his mention underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving the lineage of His people.
